text:
**Not ready to ship.** I reviewed the inventory tracker app and verified the following:

- **App component** (src/App.jsx): Only renders static "Inventory" text—no actual inventory list, no add/remove functionality, no state management
- **Test file** (test/app.test.js): Trivial test that asserts true with no meaningful validation
- **MVP requirements** (PRODUCT.md): All three features are unimplemented—view inventory, add item, remove item

The app is a placeholder stub with zero functional features. I've documented this verdict in REVIEW.md.
